title: Hook Text Overlay — Final TikTok-Ready Video
goal: Take the vertical 1080x1920 clips from sprint-054, burn the hook text from brief.hook onto the first 4 seconds of each clip using ffmpeg drawtext (Impact font, white/black border, centered), and output final MP4s to ~/kognai/final/. Store final_path back to tiktok_briefs. Output = upload-ready TikTok videos.
